summary: Reborn Coffee filed an 8-K reporting a securities purchase agreement for a private placement of common stock in two closings, raising up to $21 million in aggregate gross proceeds. The first closing of 1.4 million shares at $2.00/share raises $2.8 million; the second closing of up to 9.1 million shares at the same price raises up to $18.2 million, subject to Nasdaq and stockholder approvals. Proceeds fund flagship store expansion, brand development, and working capital. The filing is a routine capital raising, not a special situation. What to watch: stockholder vote timing and Nasdaq no-objection for first closing.
